captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a parametric noodle roller or rolling pin with modular cutting teeth. It features a central hollow cylinder serving as the main roller body, mounted on a central axle with rounded spherical ends. Extending from each end of the axle are offset handles consisting of a rectangular arm and a rounded cylindrical grip for manual rolling. The main body can support wide and narrow noodle cutter rings spaced along its length.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric noodle rolling pin in OpenSCAD with a central cylindrical roller, an axle, and offset handles. Include toggle parameters for adding wide and narrow noodle cutting rings along the length of the roller, and ensure the handles have rounded cylindrical grips.
captions.factory: The script constructs the roller assembly using boolean unions of cylinders, cubes, and spheres. The central roller is a hollow tube made by differencing two cylinders. The wide and narrow cutting rings are created using differenced cylinders scaled by 'wide_noodle_teeth' and 'narrow_noodle_teeth' parameters and translated along the Z-axis. The axle is formed using a cylinder capped with spheres, while the two offset handles are constructed using cubes for the arms and cylinders combined with spheres for the rounded grips.
